none: PAS FindID 975500: Possible Roman Casket Mount
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy and iron mount. A small cast discoid mount with a concave upper surface with protruding central boss, and with three inscribed lines around a short [4mm] cylindrical shank. A corroded shank below may indicate either a ferrous metal fixing or possibly the continuation of a lock pin. In either case, this probably came from a casket.
